| `REQ-003` | New TRDs start in draft., Unspecified content or unconfirmed assumptions prevent trd_done., Implementation state has no effect on draft status. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-004` | The transition checks valid requirements, no open or unspecified content, no unconfirmed assumptions, current digest, reason, and confirmation., The transition requires no implementation evidence. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-005` | Retired TRDs remain cataloged with stable identity and content., Retired TRDs can return only to draft through explicit confirmed restoration. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-006` | draft transitions only to trd_done or retired., trd_done transitions only to draft or retired., retired transitions only to draft., Same-state requests validate preconditions and remain byte-preserving no-ops. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-007` | New-schema operations reject not_done and done as ordinary target or filter states., No lifecycle gate checks completed requirements or implementation evidence. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |

| `REQ-010` | Title, outcome, scope, exclusion, requirement, criterion, dependency, or decision changes return trd_done to draft., Byte-identical or proven representation-only no-ops do not change revision, status, or timestamps. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-011` | Read-only commands classify or report legacy records without modifying them., Migration requires exact selection, stale-write protection, confirmation, and a reviewable receipt., An unsupported or unsafe legacy record fails without canonical or index mutation. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |

| `REQ-013` | Current placeholder-only fixtures migrate deterministically., Checked requirements or meaningful requirement/document evidence produce an exact blocking diagnostic and zero mutation. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-014` | All 14 maintained source-package files are reviewed and changed or explicitly verified unchanged., Ordinary CLI rejects legacy states., A whole-package scan finds legacy terminology only in migration-specific contexts. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
| `REQ-015` | A trd_done source is inspectable with ID, revision, digest, and lifecycle state., A draft source remains visibly unsettled., Source inspection neither mutates the TRD nor authorizes implementation. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |

| `REQ-017` | Tests cover every allowed and prohibited transition, readiness gate, no-op, material edit, legacy mapping, evidence-bearing rejection, CLI filter, index rule, atomic failure, path safety, and handoff., The full source, root, and template suites pass. | `satisfied` | 1 | None |
